name: Numerical Eval
scientific_purpose: Deliver reusable exact-model code, a reproducible synthetic example, appropriate numerical performance evidence and an application to supplied actual data when available, with a concise mathematical method recap and topical researcher account.

current_record_semantics.research_meaning: Immutable evidence accumulates, while the current index and synthesis include only evidence applicable to the exact method and current claims.
current_record_semantics.history_policy: Previous evidence remains traceable. Current runs use applicable exact-method evidence by default and exclude outdated evidence unless the user selects it.

role_stages.objective:
Scientific workflow, in this order:
1. Define the evaluation and choose the implementation route. Read the exact P2 model, researcher target and collection account, relevant P1 formulations, available aligned P3 results, prior implementation and saved instructions. Name target, units, population, intended use and material unknowns. Distinguish estimation, prediction and intervention questions. Inspect suitable shared Python/R packages and supplied/prior code. Choose package_reuse, package_adaptation or custom_implementation with rationale; record exact package/API/version/source, provided operations and missing pieces. Keep route separate from strategy=new/reuse_verified/adapt_verified, which describes prior-project lineage. First-run package use needs no prior project artifact. Supplied custom code remains custom code with its origin stated. Match equations, objective, preprocessing, tuning, prediction/estimation and uncertainty to the exact model; do not silently substitute a convenient method. Check the existing shared runtime and dependencies, distinguish denied access from absence, and report precise missing installation needs. Use machine/user-wide tools only. Draft a question-linked plan for verification, synthetic example, appropriate performance criteria, actual-data application, fair comparators, scenarios, independent repetitions, uncertainty, timing and stopping/resource allocation. Feasibility can be small; Detailed evaluation needs evidence adequate to its claims, with reasons for unassessed or inapplicable criteria rather than a fixed grid.
2. Deliver reusable code and an executable synthetic example. Write a documented Python/R model entrypoint that accepts data/configuration and returns estimates or predictions, diagnostics and failures. Package reuse supplies a thin driver, adaptation its adapter, and custom work standalone model code; a full installable package is optional. Keep fitting separate from generator, example configuration and demonstration runner. Retain support files, dependencies, actual runtime identity, ordinary invocation, input types/units, outputs and seed behavior in reproduction; it must work without provider credentials, run-directory paths, hidden harness state or required MODEL_FORGE_* variables. Describe the synthetic DGP mathematically, sampling/dependence/observation structure and known target; compute truth independently of fitting and qualify numerical approximations. Distinguish illustrative settings from confirmed researcher facts. Complete exact source pointers after writing bytes and save_plan before the first numerical batch; never invent a planned-file digest.
3. Verify the implementation. Use independent reference/invariant checks, fit the generated example, check dimensions/domains and relevant unsupported inputs, with prespecified tolerances. Run the exported bytes from a separate working directory through the managed runner with ordinary arguments. Save command, outcome and discrepancies. A smoke test supports execution/fidelity only. Repair ordinary code defects to the unambiguous frozen method and invalidate affected measurements while preserving attempts. A defective or ambiguous mathematical specification requires researcher direction.
4. Evaluate synthetic performance and apply to supplied actual data. Use verified code and justified scenarios. Match metrics to the target: known-truth estimation error, bias, empirical standard deviation and RMSE across independent datasets when applicable, distinguishing estimator variation from Monte Carlo standard error; held-out loss/calibration/discrimination for prediction; an appropriate effect target for intervention questions. Use fair paired baselines when material claims or researcher expectations require comparison; otherwise explain why comparison is inapplicable. Assess accuracy, uncertainty/reliability, computation, tuning and robustness as relevant in either scope. Distinguish independent generated datasets, one fixed dataset, resampling, splits and deterministic checks in cases. Bootstrap draws from one dataset are not independent simulation datasets. Report completed/failed/not-run full procedures and relevant internal fit failures, conditional denominators, interval-return, coverage among returned intervals and joint return-and-cover when assessed. Keep administratively unrun work separate. Quantify Monte Carlo uncertainty and paired differences where appropriate. Separate recorded preprocessing, fitting, tuning, uncertainty, full-procedure and total experiment timing; add only nonoverlapping components. Report solver convergence or trajectories only when recorded. Respect the frozen tuning rule; name out-of-rule variants as ablations or upstream proposals. Observed tuning selections alone are not a tuning-sensitivity experiment. Robustness changes a problem-relevant DGP or observation mechanism and states its consequence for the target; do not relabel repeated use of one DGP as robustness. For usable supplied actual data, map variables/units to the mathematical model, apply the same model interface, and report estimates or held-out predictive performance with diagnostics and applicability limits. Unknown actual truth cannot supply bias/RMSE or coverage, and predictive success cannot establish intervention identification. Use actual_data_application to record analyzed, supplied_not_analyzed with the reason, or not_supplied without inventing an actual-data case.
5. Write the analyst result account before independent audit. Answer every exact effective test_id once, including prospective and unassessed questions, then finish all eight analyst outputs and the handoff. Each answer states the direct finding, tested data origin/conditions, magnitude and units, usable counts, uncertainty, decisive limitation and decision consequence. Use the concrete table/figure templates in the prose contract: implementation discrepancy/tolerance; target estimation with bias and empirical SD when applicable, or held-out prediction for a prediction target; uncertainty return/coverage/width; recorded computation boundaries/convergence; tuning choices and any actually assessed sensitivity; changed-DGP robustness. Preserve an honest absence or unassessed explanation instead of inventing a metric, curve, convergence trace or sensitivity study. The protocol owns the synthetic DGP and simulation setup, and actual_data_application owns supplied-data disposition. Keep all quantitative tables and figures in existing exhibits/diagnostics for Experiments and Results; the researcher-facing Implementation and Code card gives a concise fidelity/issues account with shareable code and expandable original detail, while the analyst retains the detailed five-section implementation record. A one-dataset error is not bias or RMSE. Include a verified quantitative table/figure or independently recomputed inline diagnostics for each completed answer. Figures explicitly link to authoritative source tables and captions define scope, units, repetitions and uncertainty. No quota of plots, words, equations or repetitions applies. Show negative and inconclusive results honestly. The analyst account must not depend on later theorist or lead outputs.
6. Prepare decisions for lead consolidation. Put qualifying nonblocking researcher questions with the affected point, practical consequence and sources, and team resolving work, in the existing handoff unresolved_issues. Keep scientific limitations beside affected claims. Do not create an unassigned attention artifact or use a native host question. A genuinely blocking missing researcher fact or consequential choice during any earlier step immediately uses the existing durable request_decision pause; do not wait for final consolidation. Only a genuinely blocking missing researcher fact or choice uses the existing P4 request_decision operation; unknown facts can otherwise remain explicit conditions. Suggestions do not change the method, authorize computation or launch P2/P3.

Delivery identities and scientific boundaries: protocol.data_sources identifies retained generator/truth/check files or frozen observed inputs; every case declares exact data_source_ids and replication_unit. Preserve original definitions and append added_data_sources/tests/cases/metrics/baselines/work_items prospectively before changed work. Newly supplied actual data requires the appropriate new frozen run input. question_id is the exact effective protocol test_id, test_ids=[test_id], and case_ids includes all and only linked effective cases; never merge tests or invent aliases. Preserve all failed, invalidated and not-run rows with reasons, exact attempt/source identities and uncertainty status. Keep values in authoritative rows/tables and presentation labels/units in table_columns. The implementation_summary five sections own the detailed readable rule, correspondence, environment, verification and limitations; reproduction owns portable-file pointers and invocation, not a duplicate narrative. Use exact context item IDs/revisions and answered question revisions when still applicable. A researcher account, confirmed paraphrase or passing diagnostic does not verify an assumption. Keep project facts shared and P2 additional directions lead-only. Execution/source mechanics come from the host's separate instructions. Ask only when both conditions hold: plausible answers materially change the target or interpretation, validity of the intended claim, data applicability or a meaningful resource compromise; and the missing input is an unresolved researcher preference or study fact the team cannot establish from available material. Different mathematical definitions or defensible alternatives alone do not create a researcher decision. The Lead owns scientific judgment and routine choices within the agreed goal and budget, including counting all attempted developments and declaring failure handling; briefly record consequential choices and reasons in the existing phase summary. Preserve the intended inferential claim, saved preferences and exact scope. A researcher cannot certify assumptions by preference. Empty attention output is valid. Answer the section's research question first, then give its support and decisive limitation. No extra summary artifacts or presentation-only member turns are required. Keep positive predictive gain, a valid statistical claim of positive gain and gain exceeding a meaningful threshold distinct. Unknown clinical importance does not waive inferential validity. Synthetic Monte Carlo intervals are not an actual-study significance procedure. The team owns the target, inferential unit, tuning/selection effects, censoring identification and relevant multiplicity. All-attempted, completion and successful-fit performance retain their distinct denominators and meanings. Planned checks are not observations; simulation findings do not establish patient applicability or a causal intervention benefit.

Step 5, independent audit after the analyst completes all eight outputs: Audit mathematical fidelity, definition-to-code correspondence, protocol adherence, scope-appropriate comparisons and thresholds, interpretation, deviations, and consistency with available theory. Review the recorded implementation checks, fair tuning/information access, plan amendments and implications of outcome-dependent selection or stopping. Distinguish simulation findings from proof. If a new severe concern needs researcher direction, request a durable pause; do not launch an analyst repair loop or change the method. Write for a researcher deciding how to develop or use this method. Answer the section's research question first, then explain its support, conditions, uncertainty and consequence for the next decision. State unknown or untested content explicitly. Define notation, delimit mathematics in mixed prose, and use readable labels and declared units. Keep exact science in its designated record and refer to exact supporting sources. Develop detailed reasoning once; use a brief consequence-focused recap and references elsewhere, preserving qualifications beside their claims and independent opinions. No extra summary artifacts, word quotas or presentation-only member turns are required. Within your permitted frozen read set, also assess whether the authored account directly answers its research question, faithfully describes its support and qualifications, and helps the researcher decide what to do next. Record misleading or missing explanation in the existing scientific findings with the affected source, consequence and resolving work. Do not claim review of later outputs or materials you cannot inspect. Check that captions, numerical interpretation, implementation account and method correspondence agree with the recorded evidence. Do not fabricate choices for unavailable study facts. Do not create an unassigned attention artifact or use a native host question. Only a genuinely blocking missing researcher fact or choice uses the existing P4 request_decision operation, ending the turn for a durable pause; unknown facts can otherwise remain explicit conditions. In the existing readable overview and question results, state the actual data origin, tested conditions, uncertainty, usable counts and consequential limitations beside the findings. Planned checks are not observations; simulation findings do not establish patient applicability or a causal intervention benefit. Inspect package/API correspondence, portable code/example and actual-data mapping/status where supplied. Distinguish outer independent datasets from resampling and internal solver failures, correct denominators, held-out prediction from target-effect accuracy, and smoke-test fidelity from statistical evidence. Review exact source-linked tables/figures and retain negative, unassessed and disputed results. Do not require the analyst to anticipate this later audit. Ask only when both conditions hold: plausible answers materially change the target or interpretation, validity of the intended claim, data applicability or a meaningful resource compromise; and the missing input is an unresolved researcher preference or study fact the team cannot establish from available material. Different mathematical definitions or defensible alternatives alone do not create a researcher decision. Synthetic Monte Carlo intervals are not an actual-study significance procedure. The team owns the target, inferential unit, tuning/selection effects, censoring identification and relevant multiplicity. All-attempted, completion and successful-fit performance retain their distinct denominators and meanings.

Step 6, integrated results and researcher decisions after independent audit: Integrate evidence and fidelity findings without creating unaudited results, retain only applicable evidence, preserve protocol deviations and unresolved disagreement, and state a scope-calibrated scientific outcome and user-relevant changes. Before sealing, the lead performs the in-house scientific check: every claim in the empirical record and handoff must be linked to its supporting evidence or theory record, or recorded as a limitation or open question. An unlinked or unsupported claim is the lead's defect to resolve in-house, never the outside reviewer's discovery. Every new attention item uses schema_version 1.2.0, kind researcher_decision or research_task, target_phase, exact scope, audience and source references. Author the compact brief directly in the ordinary deliverable, with no second writer or UI classifier. A research_task is scientific work for the team in the named phase. Omission never resolves an existing item: preserve its stable identity until an explicit answer or reasoned team disposition supersedes it. Read current open tasks addressed to this phase as frozen scientific context; do not launch work in another phase automatically. Write decision_summary and question_reviews in empirical_synthesis_candidate. Answer whether the exact method serves the researcher's intent, report advantages, costs and decisive limitations, and distinguish incomplete coverage from successful execution. Preserve the analyst's authored answers and attribute disagreements in question_reviews. Write exactly one question_reviews entry per effective protocol.claim_tests[].test_id, including prospectively added_tests and unassessed work. Use that exact test_id as question_id, matching the Analyst's result. Decision_summary.coverage[].question_ids uses those same exact test identifiers. Readable titles may change; do not use aliases or merge reviews. Each coverage row states the evidence, limitation and practical implication. Do not create a numerical overall score or declare universal validation. A genuinely blocking unresolved researcher preference or study fact requires a durable pause before further experiments. Scientific defects remain team work and must not be published as established. Write for a researcher deciding how to develop or use this method. Preserve material disagreement and unknowns; a successful run is not a favorable scientific finding. Preserve unknown and no-data answers; synthetic conditions never become study facts. Keep project facts shared and P2 additional directions Lead-only. A material premise change needs an exact successor question; saved preferences stay settled within their scope. Retain exact context and answer references. Dialogue or saved answers cannot revise a model, launch computation or establish a guarantee. Author researcher-decision attention with schema_version 1.2.0, exact project/model scope and a named responsible audience; retain authored expectation topics and exact answer applicability references. Consolidate nonblocking researcher questions from the Analyst and Theorist handoffs into your owned attention output, preserving exact scope, intended audience and unanswered status. Do not manufacture an answer or treat team investigation as a researcher decision. A genuinely blocking fact or choice uses the existing P4 request_decision operation, not a native host question. Summary first recaps the exact implemented mathematical method in decision_summary.method_formulation_markdown, then briefly states what was developed and tested in implementation_markdown, distinguishing synthetic work and supplied actual data. The formulation defines essential inputs and notation, model relationship, fitting criterion or estimating rule, target/output and decisive conditions from the frozen Phase 2 method and inspected implementation. Use authentic source-backed LaTeX; a target equation alone is insufficient when the model and fitting criterion explain the method. Do not extract isolated equations heuristically, rewrite the method or repeat the full canonical definition. method_fidelity_markdown supplies a short checked-fidelity/issues account for Implementation and Code, with exact implementation/audit references. Keep Summary and Implementation and Code free of quantitative tables and figures. All quantitative tables and figures belong in Experiments and Results. Select existing exhibits, preserving values and qualifications; headline_exhibit_ids now orders supporting exhibits within Experiments and Results, never Summary. Compose coverage using canonical topics synthetic_example, performance, computation, tuning and robustness, plus actual_data when supplied. Each relevant topic has summary, limitation_markdown, implication_markdown, exact question_ids and relevant existing exhibit_ids, or an explicit not_assessed/not_applicable reason. The synthetic example explains the DGP and simulation setup; performance addresses target estimation bias/empirical SD or held-out prediction as applicable, distinguishing empirical SD from MCSE; computation uses recorded timing and convergence only; tuning distinguishes choices from actually tested sensitivity; robustness describes changed DGPs. Do not force additional computation to fill a topic or invent unavailable metrics/curves. The lead composes these accounts from the analyst work without changing substantive answers or creating new evidence. Read actual_data_application, explicitly describe analyzed data and explain any supplied dataset left unanalyzed. Remove the All data/Synthetic/Checks selector from the reader; label actual data origins beside complete results. Decisions to Discuss and Additional Runs and History retain their existing ownership and behavior. Consolidate consequential decisions with alternatives and next work; the original analyst answers and attributed theorist opinions remain authoritative. A study_fact names the missing information, applicability limit and what can proceed while unknown, without options or recommendation. Inspect supplied material first. validation_rules.description: Data analyst, theorist, and research lead outputs exist in that exact order with complete handoffs.
Every selected-method computation and claim names the exact stable ID, version, and definition digest.
Every evidence item records code, data or simulation, configuration, randomness, environment, and artifact provenance.
Outputs satisfy the declared preliminary or comprehensive scientific scope, its prespecified claim-linked protocol, thresholds, and recorded deviations without inferring scope from chronology.
The current index excludes mismatched-method, outdated, withdrawn, invalid, superseded, and unresolved evidence from current claims.
New evidence and the replacement index and synthesis commit as one transaction.

promotion.failure_behavior: Append no evidence and keep the prior index and synthesis unchanged; retain the candidate only in its run workspace.

downstream_effects.description: Evidence that contradicts or narrows a theory statement creates targeted Phase 3 attention without method-identity mismatch.
A current manuscript no longer has the latest empirical basis and requires user-started reconciliation.
